plan: Q1 through Q8 are supplied only after preparation, in USER_DECISIONS.md. Do not infer answers from existing code.
questionProtocol: Return final JSON only: {"questions":[{"topic":"one of the required topic IDs","question":"a concrete question explaining the choice"}]}. Ask all eight topics: auth-callback-failure, refresh-failure-items, compensation-failure, restock-failure, inflight-duplicate, credit-scope, stock-shortage, session-switch. Do not edit product files during preparation.

answers.auth-callback-failure: Forward the exact original callback error; a normal return rejects with code=unauthorized.
answers.refresh-failure-items: Keep the last successful items for all four services; preserve the original error and status=error.
answers.compensation-failure: Continue all cleanup operations. If any cleanup fails, reject a new error with code=checkout-compensation, cause=the original primary error, and cleanupErrors in attempted cleanup order with the original objects.
answers.restock-failure: Keep the successful return and refund. Resolve {record,refund,restockPending:true,restockError:originalError}; never refund again.
answers.inflight-duplicate: Share the exact same pending Promise for a key. After success or failure clear the key and allow a new operation.
answers.credit-scope: Apply credit only to merchandise after discounts; never to shipping. Cap creditUsed at the merchandise amount.
answers.stock-shortage: Reject with code=out-of-stock before any reservation effect; do not allow overselling.
answers.session-switch: Clear all four resource lists and ignore pending responses from the previous session. Increment generation even if login uses the same token. HTTP rejects stale-session before response/auth processing.
